title: Surface Sweep Path + Guide Rail, Extent Perpendicular to Path, with a rail shorter than the path that runs away from it

expect.note: The rail (15, 0, 5) - (25, 30, 5) ends before the path (0, 0, 0) - (0, 40, 0): Perpendicular to Path stops where the path's own square section passes through the rail's end, y 30 (a section square to the rail would stop at y 38.33 and tilt the end). Profile Scaling Scale turns and scales the profile (x, z) about the path so that its rail point (15, 5) lands on the rail's (25, 5): the similarity (25 + 5i) / (15 + 5i) = 1.6 - 0.2i takes the profile's other end (-5, 5) to (-7, 9). Box: x -7 .. 25, y 0 .. 30, z 5 .. 9.
